baseline_models.focus_anchor: رفع السماوات؛ سخر الشمس والقمر؛ كل يجري لأجل مسمى؛ يدبر الأمر ويفصل الآيات
baseline_models.mechanism: Elevation, purposive subjection, regular motion to a bounded time, outcome-aware management, and articulated signs form one timed administration rather than a list of unrelated wonders.

activation_trace.role: Physical elevation supplies the raised spatial field on which the mechanism operates.
Subjection that drives something toward a purpose makes the luminaries functional components.
Flowing motion supplies the ongoing execution of the order.
A bounded duration gives every course a temporal limit.
Considering an affair's outcome makes governance prospective rather than merely initiatory.
Detailing parts and meanings makes the administered order cognitively legible.

changed_reading.before: The ayah lists feats of divine power in the sky.
changed_reading.after: The ayah presents the cosmos as a timed administration whose motions, limits, and explanations are coordinated toward encounter.

baseline_models.mechanism: Negation, architectural support, and sight leave two live attachments: the heavens are seen raised with no pillars, or the negated pillars are specifically pillars one can see, leaving support outside perception.

activation_trace.role: Negation and exclusion open the support phrase's two attachment possibilities.
Propping a thing with a support supplies the literal architectural expectation being denied or hidden.
Vision can qualify either the raised heavens or the availability of their supports to observers.

changed_reading.before: The heavens simply have no pillars.
changed_reading.after: Two readings coexist: visible heavens need no pillars, or their sustaining structure is real but not an object of sight.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: ثم استوى على العرش ... يدبر الأمر
baseline_models.mechanism: Settling above, the royal seat, the frame or stability of an affair, and outcome-aware management make the throne clause an executive hinge between elevation and ongoing governance.

activation_trace.role: Rising and settling on something supplies the transition to a governing position.
The elevated royal seat supplies sovereign authority.
The stable frame of an affair connects throne imagery to organized rule.
Management by attending to outcomes supplies the throne's operative consequence.

changed_reading.before: The throne clause is a spatial enthronement inserted between creation statements.
changed_reading.after: It functions as the governing frame from which bounded motions and disclosed signs are continuously coordinated.

baseline_models.mechanism: Regular course, fixed duration, naming, and the packet's non-dominant mark branch allow the limit to be both assigned and recognizable, not merely an anonymous stopping point.

activation_trace.role: A customary running way makes each motion a regulated course.
The time-limit branch supplies the course's bound.
Naming as designation gives the term an assigned identity.
A visible identifying mark supplies an exploratory sense in which the assigned limit can become legible through effects.

changed_reading.before: Each body moves until an unspecified deadline that happens to have a name.
changed_reading.after: Each follows an assigned course toward a limit whose designation also marks it for recognition, though the mark activation remains form-distant.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يدبر الأمر يفصل الآيات لعلكم بلقاء ربكم توقنون
baseline_models.mechanism: Outcome-aware governance is broken into distinct visible signs; those signs are arranged to move the reader from observation toward stable knowledge of a face-to-face encounter.

activation_trace.role: Prospective management supplies the causal order behind the signs.
Separating elements until their boundaries appear supplies an articulated sequence rather than an undivided display.
The visible-sign branch makes the separated elements evidentiary.
Two things meeting face-to-face supplies the destination of the evidentiary path.
Stable knowledge with doubt removed supplies the intended cognitive change.

changed_reading.before: The signs prove that God exists.
changed_reading.after: The signs are a deliberately articulated route from governed effects to certainty about a coming encounter with the governing Lord.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate turn from raised heavens to extended earth, stabilizers, channels, shared origins, and distributed irrigation revises pillar imagery into relational support visible through coordinated effects rather than vertical columns.

activation_trace.role: Literal propping supplies the columnar support model being revised.
Connected horizontal extension supplies a field held together without column imagery.
Fixity and rooted stability provide an explicit terrestrial stabilizing operation.
Water channels cutting through land add moving relations to the support system.
Kinship from one root supplies shared origin beneath differentiated visible forms.
A distributed share and channel of irrigation makes one source sustain varied outputs.

structural_cues: 13:3 immediately mirrors the focus's heavens with earth; 13:4 then stresses adjacent parcels, one water, and unequal fruit.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies terrestrial extension, fixity, channels, common roots, and one-water differentiation; I infer these effects as an analogy for non-columnar support; alternatively they are only a heaven-earth contrast.

changed_reading.before: Support is either absent or hidden as a pillar-like object.
changed_reading.after: A third possibility becomes live: sustaining structure can be distributed among relations and known by stable, differentiated effects rather than seen as pillars.

context_deltas.mechanism: Pregnancy, decrease, increase, womb, and exact measure turn the named term from a mere terminal instant into a managed developmental interval whose internal phases are known and calibrated.

activation_trace.role: The bounded duration supplies the developmental interval's outer limit.
Outcome-aware management supplies direction through the interval.
Hidden pregnancy and fruit supply a concrete process unfolding toward a term.
Decrease supplies one measurable direction of change.
The womb provides the concealed chamber in which timed development occurs.
Increase and growth supply the opposite developmental direction.
Planning by measure converts variation into calibrated governance.

structural_cues: 13:8 orders hidden carrying, decrease, increase, and the statement that every thing is with a measure.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies a measured gestational sequence; I map its phased temporality onto the focus's named course and management; alternatively the sequence only illustrates exhaustive knowledge.

changed_reading.before: The named term is only where motion stops.
changed_reading.after: The term can govern the whole measured development of a course, including concealed decrease and increase before its completion.

context_deltas.mechanism: What sight catches as lightning develops through generated heavy cloud, descent, measured valleys, and flood flow; the raised heaven is therefore an active transfer infrastructure whose hidden governance becomes visible downstream.

activation_trace.role: Flowing motion anchors the later hydrological process back in the focus.
Shown lightning makes one stage perceptible while the full mechanism remains larger than sight.
A brief flash supplies the visible onset of the circuit.
Generating something supplies active formation rather than a static sky.
Drawing and extending the cloud supplies transport across the raised field.
Weight gives the cloud a load that the circuit carries.
Flood flow supplies the downstream realization of heavenly transfer.
A valley as the flood's path channels the descending material.
Each valley's capacity limits and differentiates the common flow.

structural_cues: 13:12-17 forms a sequence from visible flash through heavy cloud and thunder to descending water, measured channels, and terrestrial persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies the ordered weather-to-valley sequence; I infer a continuous infrastructure as an instance of unseen management; alternatively the units are separate signs with no asserted causal chain beyond rainfall.

changed_reading.before: Raised heavens and running luminaries form a static architectural panorama.
changed_reading.after: The heavens operate as a dynamic transfer field: governance unseen at one stage becomes legible as measured flow and differentiated effects at another.

context_deltas.mechanism: The sun's governed course writes moving shadows at morning and evening; those shadows enact prostration across willing and unwilling subjects, converting celestial subjection into a visible temporal practice on earth.

activation_trace.role: Driving something toward a purpose anchors the later shadow movement in celestial subjection.
The sun supplies the moving light source that produces the temporal inscription.
Humbling and lowering gives the shadow's motion a ritual posture.
Willing obedience supplies one mode of participation in the governed order.
Aversion supplies the competing mode while the bodily effect still occurs.
The shadow cast by a standing body makes cosmic motion materially legible.
Morning departure marks one edge of the daily cycle.
Late-day time marks the other edge of the recurring cycle.

structural_cues: 13:15 joins heavens, earth, willing/unwilling response, shadows, and the two daily temporal edges in one sentence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies subjection in the focus and shadow-prostration at temporal edges; I infer solar causation as the bridge; alternatively prostration is rhetorical personification rather than a physical reading of the sun's course.

changed_reading.before: Subjugating the sun and moon means only mechanical control.
changed_reading.after: Their governed motion also produces an involuntary daily liturgy in bodies and shadows, making cosmic obedience socially and visually present.

context_deltas.mechanism: Repeated foam, falsehood, passing away, discarded residue, benefit, and persistence turn the detailing of signs into an assay: time and flow expose what merely rides the surface and what remains useful in the earth.

activation_trace.role: Separating until a boundary appears anchors the assay in the focus's detailing of signs.
Visible signs make the separated results available as evidence.
Floating foam supplies the conspicuous but ungrounded layer tested by the process.
Loss of truth and stability identifies the foam's epistemic analogue.
Passing away supplies the temporal removal of the false surface.
Discarded residue gives the removed surface a material destination.
Benefit supplies the criterion for the contrasting retained material.
Stable waiting and persistence supply the test's durable outcome.

structural_cues: 13:17 repeats foam across water and fire, explicitly contrasts truth and falsehood, then contrasts disappearance with terrestrial persistence.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies a material parable of separation over time; I infer it as a worked example of how detailed signs generate certainty; alternatively it illustrates truth and falsehood without specifying the focus's disclosure method.

changed_reading.before: Detailing signs means verbally explaining discrete proofs.
changed_reading.after: Detailing can be an experiential separation process in which flow, time, and consequence distinguish flashy surface from enduring benefit.

context_deltas.mechanism: The challenge to name alleged partners is followed by alternatives of reporting something outside divine knowledge or uttering only surface speech; this makes the focus's named term a reality-accountable registration rather than a label that creates its referent.

activation_trace.role: Naming as designation anchors the contextual naming test in the focus's named term.
An identifying mark keeps the term's designation tied to recognizable reality.
The command to name the partners supplies the direct contextual test of designation.
A report that arrives and is conveyed asks whether the name carries real information.
Disclosure to a knower supplies the reality condition against which the report is tested.
Surface appearance supplies the alternative of a name that is only outward speech.
Saying what is not supplies the failure mode of designation without a real referent.

structural_cues: 13:33 places 'name them' between invented partners and the alternatives of unknown information or merely apparent speech.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies a polemic that tests names against knowledge and surface speech; I infer a contrast with the focus's named term; alternatively the shared root is incidental and the partner polemic does not qualify cosmic deadlines.

changed_reading.before: Named means only that authority has verbally assigned a deadline.
changed_reading.after: A truly named term is a knowledge-backed designation with real governance behind it, unlike naming that merely projects an agency into speech.

context_deltas.mechanism: The same running predicate describes bounded celestial courses and promised garden rivers, while the garden's yield and shade are enduring; the named term can therefore mark a transition between temporal regimes rather than universal cessation of every flow.

activation_trace.role: Running flow supplies the repeated motion shared by the two scenes.
The fixed temporal bound characterizes the focus's celestial running.
Garden rivers repeat the focus's flowing predicate in a promised end-state.
A promise fixed to a future horizon places the garden beyond the present course.
Flow from beneath supplies a stable spatial relation unlike an overhead celestial track.
Duration and persistence supply the contrasting temporal quality of the garden's provision.

structural_cues: 13:35 repeats 'runs' but places it beside enduring yield and shade, then labels both garden and fire as outcomes.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies repeated running plus bounded time in the focus and enduring provision in the garden; I infer a temporal contrast and transition; alternatively permanence modifies only yield and shade, not the rivers or the focus's scope.

changed_reading.before: Every running thing simply terminates at its deadline.
changed_reading.after: The bounded celestial run may carry creation toward another regime in which flow remains but its provision is characterized by endurance.

context_deltas.mechanism: Every term is paired with an inscription, then erasure and establishment occur before a source-book; the named term becomes a registered allocation nested within active administration rather than an inert, self-executing fate.

activation_trace.role: A fixed duration anchors the contextual inscription back in the focus's named term.
The repeated term makes the contextual writing a direct specification of the focus's bound.
An inscription that establishes a ruling or measure gives each term administrative registration.
Erasing an effect supplies live removal within the registered order.
Persistence and establishment supply the opposite administrative operation.
An origin, collection, and reference point supplies the higher-order register in which changes are nested.
The written object supplies the enduring reference form of that register.

structural_cues: 13:38 ends with every term having a writing; 13:39 immediately juxtaposes erasing, establishing, and the source-book.
context_deltas.reader_inference: Packet supplies direct term-writing equivalence followed by erasure, establishment, and a source register; I infer nested administration of manifested terms; alternatively erasure and establishment concern other contents and leave every term wholly fixed.

changed_reading.before: A named term is a fixed deadline operating like impersonal fate.
changed_reading.after: It is a sovereignly inscribed allocation: stable as registered order yet continuously dependent on the higher administration that erases, establishes, and holds the source register.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it crosses royal and horticultural domains; it remains anchored in the focus's explicit trellis branch for عرش and is activated by nearby grapes and fruit; downstream prose should present it only as an exploratory material analogy, not replace the throne's royal sense.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: العرش, read through its trellis branch within the raised and governed creation

activation_trace.role: A raised trellis for vines supplies an alternate material image of an ordering frame.
Elevation keeps the trellis image spatially attached to the focus's raised architecture.
Ripened fruit activates the productive consequence of a supporting frame.
Grapes provide the precise crop normally carried by a trellis.

changed_reading.before: The throne is only a royal seat above creation.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, it can also image a raised trellising frame under which differentiated creation is ordered toward fruit.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is branch-distant because جري normally contributes motion here; it remains anchored in 'each runs,' purposive subjection, and the packet's agent branch, with contextual sending as activation; downstream prose should qualify it as an administrative metaphor, not claim that the luminaries are literally messengers.

activation_trace.role: Purpose-directed subjection gives the running entities an assigned function.
The runner as agent or envoy activates an administrative rather than merely kinematic image.
Sending and dispatch supplies the contextual commissioning relation.

changed_reading.before: The sun and moon are inert bodies moving on controlled paths.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, they are commissioned runners executing bounded assignments within the management of the affair.

strongest_changes: The pillar phrase preserves absent-support and unseen-support readings, then terrestrial networks add a third model of distributed support visible through effects.
The named term expands from an endpoint into measured development, reality-accountable designation, and an inscribed allocation under active administration.
Weather, valleys, shadows, and foam turn cosmic governance from a static tableau into flows that reveal ordering, obedience, and discernment over time.
Repeated running alongside enduring garden provision keeps a live contrast between finite cosmic courses and a later regime of persistent benefit.
summary.what_was_special: The packet's split mapped roots made naming also activate marking, while repeated focus roots in later ayat connected sight, running, term, and throne to material sequences without collapsing their competing readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The attachment of ترونها does not settle whether supports are absent or merely unseen.
It remains uncertain whether 13:39's erasure and establishment directly govern the terms of 13:38 or another class of written contents.
The permanence in 13:35 explicitly qualifies yield and shade, so its contrast with bounded running should not be extended to every garden feature without caution.
The trellis and commissioned-runner outliers are productive analogies, not lexical replacements for throne and ordinary celestial motion.
